Name: Silenced Rasp
Author: ampedPF
Description:
Tested with Stardew Valley 1.6.  
This content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] allows you to replace the rasping sounds with silence.  
Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url].  
You can pick which one to mute with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].  
Restart the game after you've made any changes.

Downloads.Description: Needs SMAPI 4.0.0 or later & Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later

Manifest.Name: Silenced Rasp
Manifest.Description: Silence the sound when opening chests, doors, shipping bin and trash can.
Manifest.Author: ampedPF
